Marco Diaz: Heads-up — RetailEdge (hardware partner) requests a coordinated marketplace launch: listing, co-authored blog, and press quote. 6-week target. Need a short playbook we can hand them.
Priya Patel: Copy question — single listing with bundle CTA or separate vendor tile + bundle modal?
Alice Nguyen: I can prototype a modal with feature matrix by Friday. Will include mobile layout.
Samir Khan: Ops checklist: AMI/image, quick-install script, compatibility cert, billing SKU mapping, support contacts. Plan dry-run in launch-2 week.
Jenna Ortiz: Comms wants one co-branded blog, 1 partner quote + 1 Redwood quote, and a social kit. Partner PR must approve quote text.
legal-bot: Reminder: asset use requires signed RetailEdge_BrandLicense_v2. NDA addendum needed if we publish performance metrics.
Marco Diaz: I'll assemble a 1-page playbook: assets, landing variants, cadence, embargo rules, rollback, owners. Posting draft here tomorrow EOD.
Priya Patel: I'll ask RetailEdge for FR/DE translations; fallback to L10n if needed. Adding billing mapping notes to the sheet.
Alice Nguyen: Adding small A/B flag so we can measure tile vs modal conversion.
Jenna Ortiz: Marco — can you schedule a 30m PR sync with RetailEdge (include their PR lead) next Tue 10am PT? I'll prep blog outline.
Marco Diaz: Scheduled. Action list: Alice prototype (Fri), Priya copy + translation ask (Wed), Jenna blog draft (Mon), Legal chase assets (Wed).
